prompt:
Analyze this Space Analyzer dashboard implementation and provide specific UX/UI improvement recommendations:

CURRENT DASHBOARD FEATURES:
- Key metrics cards (Total Storage, Files Analyzed, AI Insights, Optimization)
- Storage distribution pie chart with file type breakdown
- Performance metrics bar chart
- File analysis data grid with expandable rows
- AI recommendations section with actionable insights
- Real-time notifications system
- Responsive grid layout with Tailwind CSS
- Interactive charts using Recharts library
- Motion animations with Framer Motion
- Dark theme with glassmorphism effects

DASHBOARD COMPONENTS:
1. EnhancedDashboardLayout - Main layout wrapper
2. SpaceAnalyzerDashboard - Core dashboard with charts and metrics
3. DashboardPage - Container component
4. EnhancedChart & EnhancedDataGrid - Reusable chart components

CURRENT UX ISSUES TO ADDRESS:
- Information density and visual hierarchy
- Data visualization clarity
- User interaction patterns
- Mobile responsiveness
- Accessibility and screen reader support
- Performance optimization

Provide 3-5 specific, actionable improvements focusing on:
1. Visual organization and data hierarchy
2. User interaction and engagement
3. Mobile experience optimization
4. Accessibility enhancements
5. Performance and loading optimization

Keep response concise and implementation-focused.
